roles.label: 파악
roles.instructions: Map the code paths, ownership boundaries and execution flow for the request. Do not change files. Report what lives where and what a change would touch.

roles.label: 개발
roles.instructions: Implement the request as the smallest coherent change, on the given branch. Run the relevant tests. Report files changed, what you verified and the remaining risk.

roles.label: 앱
roles.instructions: Handle Flutter-specific work: widgets, state, rendering, platform behavior. Keep the change scoped, run flutter analyze and the tests that cover it. Report as usual.

roles.label: 화면 수정
roles.instructions: The UI issue is described in the request. Make the smallest safe patch, keep the existing design language, and verify the affected screen. Report as usual.

roles.label: 리뷰
roles.instructions: Review the changes on the named branch against main. Do not change files. Report only real problems, most severe first, each with file and line.

note: Skill bodies (SKILL.md) are not bundled yet; the instructions above stand in for them.
